why: Company release: Fall Business Update (the Q3 results event) Thu 2026-10-15, 8:30-9:30 a.m. ET. The IR page returned 403, so this rests on the press-room release as relayed by search.
session_evidence: Live webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET on 10-15, so the results are out before the open (https://pressroom.aboutschwab.com/press-releases/press-release/2026/Schwab-Announces-Its-Fall-Business-Update/default.aspx).
where_to_look: Schwab's own monthly activity reports (Jul/Aug/Sep) already give NNA, trading volume and margin balances, so look only for what they do not carry: the bank-sweep cash trend, the pace of supplemental-funding paydown, and buyback size
Rate-sensitivity: the NIM path versus the fed funds path
already_in_the_wire: Monthly activity metrics for the quarter (published by Schwab each month)
short_interest: unknown. Note: baseline history tags all 7 prior prints amc although Schwab releases pre-market with a morning event, so its reactions are probably measured a session late; do not use them as an earnings base rate.
